records.summary: Silicon-validated UART 16550-compatible serial controller with an APB-style wrapper.
records.summary_zh: 面向 SoC 串口控制台的 UART 16550 兼容控制器，带本地 APB 风格封装，支持收发 FIFO、可编程波特率分频和基础中断/线路控制寄存器；当前代码来自 2025-06-27 流片工程并已完成硅验证。
not_recommended_for: designs requiring a pinned upstream release without extra provenance work
records.next_action: attach-tapeout-provenance-and-basic-verification-reports

records.summary: APB4-based UART controller with configurable serial format, TX/RX FIFOs, programmable baud divider, and maskable interrupts.
records.summary_zh: 基于 APB4 总线的 UART 控制器，支持可配置数据位、停止位、校验位、可编程波特率分频、独立收发 FIFO 和可屏蔽中断；当前代码为 20250627 流片工程快照，并记录为已硅验证候选 IP。
records.next_action: Attach tapeout validation evidence, complete license file review, and run a reproducible simulation/lint baseline.

records.summary: APB4-accessible architecture information register block for SoC, process, vendor, and tapeout date metadata.
records.summary_zh: 通过 APB4 访问的架构信息寄存器模块，用于记录 SoC 时钟/SRAM 配置、流片类型、厂商、工艺、用户标识和流片日期等元数据；当前代码来自 20250627 流片工程快照。
not_recommended_for: designs requiring immutable read-only registers without reviewing write-enable policy
records.next_action: Attach tapeout validation evidence and run a reproducible simulation/lint baseline.

records.summary: APB4-based single-master I2C controller with programmable prescaler, 7-bit addressing, and maskable transfer interrupt.
records.summary_zh: 基于 APB4 总线的单主 I2C 控制器，兼容 Philips I2C 标准，支持可编程预分频、7 位寻址、100K/400K/1Mbps 速率场景以及可屏蔽传输中断；当前代码来自 20250627 流片工程快照。
records.next_action: Attach tapeout validation evidence and run a reproducible simulation/lint baseline.

records.summary: APB4-based 32-channel GPIO controller with direction control, alternate-function muxing, and configurable input interrupts.
records.summary_zh: 基于 APB4 总线的 32 路 GPIO 控制器，支持输入/输出方向配置、软件与复用功能输出选择、可屏蔽输入中断，以及高/低电平和上升/下降沿触发模式；当前代码来自 20250627 流片工程快照。
not_recommended_for: designs requiring more than 32 GPIO channels without RTL changes
records.next_action: Attach tapeout validation evidence and run a reproducible simulation/lint baseline.

records.summary: APB4-based SPI master controller with programmable prescaler, standard/dual/quad modes, FIFOs, chip select control, and maskable interrupts.
records.summary_zh: 基于 APB4 总线的 SPI 主控制器，兼容 Motorola SPI 标准，支持标准/双线/四线模式、可编程分频、片选控制、独立收发 FIFO、可配置帧格式和可屏蔽收发中断；当前代码来自 20250627 流片工程快照。
records.next_action: Attach tapeout validation evidence and run a reproducible simulation/lint baseline.

records.summary: APB4-based programmable timer with prescaler, 32-bit counter and compare register, auto reload, capture mode, and overflow interrupt.
records.summary_zh: 基于 APB4 总线的可编程定时器，支持可在线修改的预分频、32 位计数/比较寄存器、自动重载、内外部时钟源、向上/向下计数、输入捕获和可屏蔽溢出中断；当前代码来自 20250627 流片工程快照。
records.next_action: Attach tapeout validation evidence and run a reproducible simulation/lint baseline.

records.summary: APB4-based pseudo-random number generator using a 32-bit LFSR with programmable seed and one random word per cycle.
records.summary_zh: 基于 APB4 总线的伪随机数发生器，内部使用 32 位最大序列 LFSR，支持可编程种子寄存器，并可每周期产生一个 32 位随机数；当前代码来自 20250627 流片工程快照。
records.next_action: Attach tapeout validation evidence and run a reproducible simulation/lint baseline.

records.summary: APB4-based four-channel edge-aligned PWM controller with programmable prescaler, 16-bit counter, compare registers, auto reload, and overflow interrupt.
records.summary_zh: 基于 APB4 总线的四通道边沿对齐 PWM 控制器，支持可在线修改的预分频、16 位向上计数器、比较寄存器、自动重载和可屏蔽溢出中断；当前代码来自 20250627 流片工程快照。
records.next_action: Attach tapeout validation evidence and run a reproducible simulation/lint baseline.

records.summary: APB4-based PS/2 keyboard controller with configurable receive FIFO depth and maskable FIFO-not-empty interrupt.
records.summary_zh: 基于 APB4 总线的 PS/2 键盘控制器，支持 PS/2 键盘接收、可配置接收 FIFO 深度和可屏蔽 FIFO 非空中断，并提供键盘测试模型；当前代码来自 20250627 流片工程快照。
records.next_action: Attach tapeout validation evidence and run a reproducible simulation/lint baseline.

records.summary: AXI4-based PSRAM controller for serial RAM devices with programmable prescaler and SPI/QPI/OPI-oriented PSRAM core support.
records.summary_zh: 基于 AXI4 总线的 PSRAM 控制器，面向串行 RAM 设备，包含 AXI4 从端 FSM、PSRAM 核心控制逻辑、可编程分频以及 SPI/QPI/OPI 模式相关接口支持；当前代码来自 20250627 流片工程快照。
records.next_action: Attach tapeout validation evidence and run a reproducible simulation/lint baseline.

records.summary: APB4-based CRC controller supporting CRC8, CRC16, CRC32 polynomials, byte/bit reversal controls, programmable seed, and XOR output.
records.summary_zh: 基于 APB4 总线的 CRC 控制器，支持 CRC8、CRC16、CRC32 多项式、输入字节反转、输出位反转、可编程初值和输出异或寄存器，内部基于 LFSR 实现；当前代码来自 20250627 流片工程快照。
records.next_action: Attach tapeout validation evidence and run a reproducible simulation/lint baseline.

records.summary: APB4-based RISC-V PLIC-compatible interrupt controller for one hart target, up to 31 external interrupt sources, priorities, masks, and pending state.
records.summary_zh: 基于 APB4 总线的 RISC-V PLIC 兼容中断控制器，面向单 hart 目标，支持最多 31 路外部中断、16 级优先级、边沿/电平触发配置、屏蔽位和 pending 状态管理；当前代码来自 20250627 流片工程快照。
records.next_action: Attach tapeout validation evidence and run a reproducible simulation/lint baseline.

records.summary: APB4-based reset and clock unit with multiple clock sources, programmable clock output, core clock division, and clock selection controls.
records.summary_zh: 基于 APB4 总线的复位与时钟控制单元，支持高速/低速/音频外部时钟源、可编程时钟输出、核心多路分频时钟生成以及时钟频率配置和核心选择控制；当前代码来自 20250627 流片工程快照。
records.next_action: Attach tapeout validation evidence and run a reproducible simulation/lint baseline.

records.summary: APB4-based real-time counter with programmable prescaler, 32-bit counter and alarm register, write protection, read resynchronization, and three interrupts.
records.summary_zh: 基于 APB4 总线的实时时钟控制器，支持可在线修改的预分频、32 位向上计数器与闹钟寄存器、写保护、读重同步，以及秒中断、溢出中断和闹钟中断；当前代码来自 20250627 流片工程快照。
records.next_action: Attach tapeout validation evidence and run a reproducible simulation/lint baseline.

records.summary: APB4-based RISC-V CLINT-style local interrupt controller with 64-bit mtime/mtimecmp timer registers and software interrupt support.
records.summary_zh: 基于 APB4 总线的 RISC-V CLINT 风格本地中断控制器，支持 64 位 mtime/mtimecmp 定时器寄存器和软件中断，用于小型 SoC 的机器定时器与本地中断集成；当前代码来自 20250627 流片工程快照。
records.next_action: Attach tapeout validation evidence and run a reproducible simulation/lint baseline.

records.summary: 55nm process PLL IP targeting 500 MHz to 1200 MHz output with integer continuous division, 5 MHz to 40 MHz input, and period jitter below 30 ps.
records.summary_zh: 55nm 制程 PLL IP，面向 1.2V core 电压设计，支持 5MHz 到 40MHz 输入、500MHz 到 1200MHz 输出、连续整数分频，目标面积小于 200um x 200um，功耗小于 1.5mA，Period jitter 小于 30ps；Test Chip 完整电路与 GDS 文件以及行为模型源码待入库。
languages: Verilog-A or behavioral model source planned
records.next_action: Add behavior model, Test Chip circuit/GDS provenance, process collateral constraints, and silicon characterization results after chip return.

records.summary: 55nm DDR3/DDR2 PHY IP using a DFI interface between the DDR controller and DDR SDRAM devices, targeting DDR3-800 to DDR3-1600 and DDR2-667 to DDR2-1066 speed grades.
records.summary_zh: 55nm 制程 DDR3/2 PHY IP，通过 DFI 接口与 DDR 控制器交互，连接 DDR3 颗粒，支持 DDR3-800 到 DDR3-1600，并兼容 DDR2-667 到 DDR2-1066；当前状态为正在验证中。
records.next_action: Attach PHY deliverables, DFI timing documentation, supported SDRAM configuration matrix, and verification evidence.

records.summary: DDR3 memory controller intended to connect to a DDR PHY through DFI and drive external DDR3 SDRAM devices as a complete memory subsystem.
records.summary_zh: DDR3 内存控制器，通过 DFI 接口连接 DDR PHY，再由 PHY 连接 DDR3 颗粒；需要配合相应 PHY 才能完整工作，当前正在开发中。
records.next_action: Add controller RTL, register/configuration documentation, DFI timing assumptions, and verification plan.

records.summary: Basic SoC interconnect bus supporting 1 to 16 AXI masters, a single AHB master, up to 32 AXI slaves, up to 32 AHB slaves, and up to 31 external APB slaves through an AHB-to-APB bridge.
records.summary_zh: 基础互联总线，支持 1 到 16 个 AXI Master、单 AHB master、最多 32 个 AXI slaves、32 个 AHB slaves，并通过 AHB-to-APB bridge 支持最多 31 个外部 APB slaves；最大总线宽度 128bits，当前正在开发中。
records.next_action: Add bus fabric RTL, configuration schema, arbitration/address mapping documentation, and protocol verification evidence.

records.summary: RISC-V RV32IMAC processor core with instruction and data caches, multi-stage pipeline, AXI memory interface, RISC-V Debug support, and CoreMark/MHz above 2.
records.summary_zh: RISCV32IMAC 处理器，包含 ICache 和 DCache、多级流水线结构、AXI 总线访存接口、RISC-V Debug 调试支持，CoreMark/MHz 在 2 分以上；当前正在验证中，准备流片验证。
records.next_action: Add CPU RTL, ISA compliance results, CoreMark logs, debug validation, cache behavior documentation, and tapeout verification evidence.
